page.overview:
Who is Unforgivable Mask?

Unforgivable Mask is a hidden One Piece character, much like Pandaman. He is, in fact, Pandaman's rival.

Unforgivable Mask's appearance is that of a muscle-bound figure with a panda face as a mask. He wears black swim briefs and boots. Unlike Pandaman (and others with a similar style), who appears to have an authentic panda's head, Unforgivable Mask actually appears to be wearing a mask.

Unforgivable Mask was hired by Tomato Gang to track down Pandaman.
